description: This file provides Serbian localization strings for the Select2 JavaScript plugin, version 4.0.6-rc.1, including various UI messages and behaviors.

methods.name: errorLoading
methods.description: Returns a message indicating loading results failed.

methods.name: inputTooLong
methods.description: Returns a message prompting user to delete excess characters.

methods.name: inputTooShort
methods.description: Returns a message prompting user to enter more characters.

methods.name: loadingMore
methods.description: Returns a message indicating more results are being loaded.

methods.name: maximumSelected
methods.description: Returns a message indicating the maximum number of selections allowed.

methods.name: noResults
methods.description: Returns a message indicating no search results found.

methods.name: searching
methods.description: Returns a message indicating a search is in progress.
